public_rationale: An eight-benchmark spatial study published August 18, 2025, found GPT-5 below human performance in several capabilities, including mental reconstruction and perspective-taking [e1]. It also found substantial improvements and human-level performance in some categories [e2]. These results establish spatial strengths and limitations under the study's settings, but neither persistent generalization failures across ordinary task families after varied elicitation nor broad, dependable unaided competence [e1, e2]. They therefore do not settle the general-purpose AGI claim [e1, e2].
limitations: The evidence comes from one spatial study and does not establish capability across the broader range of unfamiliar tasks [e1, e2].
Results under specified prompts and token budgets do not establish permanent model limits or an operational boundary for general-purpose intelligence [e1, e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-5 by itself will not be a general-purpose AGI capable of arbitrary tasks.

statement.excerpt: GPT-5 by itself won’t be a general purpose artificial general intelligence capable of taking on arbitrary tasks.
statement.document_title: What to Expect When You’re Expecting … GPT-5

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is broad competence at unfamiliar, feasible tasks, rather than literal success at every conceivable task.
‘By itself’ excludes external reasoning systems, specialist controllers and retrieval tools. Ordinary input and output interfaces are permitted.
The target is the original GPT-5 system, not every later model carrying a GPT-5 family name.
No deadline is supplied. Release is not treated as an unstated deadline.
criteria.support_condition: Controlled evaluations establish substantial, persistent failures of generalization across ordinary task families in GPT-5 itself, after reasonable attempts to elicit its capabilities.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Controlled evaluations establish broad, dependable competence on unfamiliar tasks using GPT-5 alone, sufficient for the ordinary meaning of general-purpose intelligence.

evidence.explanation: The eight-benchmark study reports substantial gaps in several spatial capabilities. This supports the predicted limitation, but establishes performance under the study's protocols rather than a definitive classification of general intelligence.
The same evaluation finds substantial strengths, including human-level results in some categories. Its findings do not justify describing GPT-5 as uniformly incapable of spatial reasoning.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Reproducible evaluations of original GPT-5 across unfamiliar, feasible task families, excluding external reasoning systems, specialist controllers, and retrieval tools. They should test reasonable prompting and reasoning budgets, include human comparisons, and establish either broad dependable competence or persistent generalization failures.
